Banana Graham Dessert
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 29, 2009 - 12:32am

Ingredients




1 small Instant sugar-free vanilla pudding mix
2 3/4 cups Cold skim milk
8 ounces Nonfat sour cream
12 Reduced-fat graham crackers
2 lrg Firm bananas, sliced

Preparation

1 In a mixing bowl, beat pudding mix and milk on low speed for 2 minutes. 2 Fold in sour cream. Let stand for 5 minutes. In a 3-qt. bowl, layer a third of the gra ham crackers, bananas and pudding mix ture. Repeat layers twice. 3 Refrigerate.
